title: The Voluptuous Apocalypse
genre: argumentative institutional essay with composite scenes
narrativeSpine: A fantasy of canceled obligations reveals the deletion deficit of institutions; the essay then tests that relief against the human work collapse cannot erase.
firstSceneDraft: The Voluptuous Apocalypse examines the relief that can hide inside fantasies of catastrophe.
Its argumentative essay opens with disaster news and an approaching nine-o'clock meeting.
The imagined interruption promises release from procedures that seem unable to end themselves.
The book treats that attraction as a question about institutions, not support for destruction.
visualActionProposal: A colorful office clock and multiplying review trays contrast with a deliberately removable procedure shelf; preserve ordinary life and care instead of disaster spectacle.
